text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Victoire Pisa got injured,
I brought 
her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry... But I'm 
all right now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Now that the treatment is finished,
let us 
return to training right away.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I cannot afford to disrupt the 
training regimen that Trainer has put 
together for me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:

a struggle to settle on this menu...

Understood.
I will make sure to get plenty 
of rest now so that I don't fall behind 
any further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Victoire Pisa's injury
worsened, I 
decided to have her take a break and rest 
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after making her promise to tell 
me immediately if it hurt, we returned to 
training—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, yeah. Looks like she's okay. 
Thank goodness it wasn't a serious injury.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Still,
I can't cause any more trouble for 
Trainer. Carefully, very carefully..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not pushing too hard paid off, and she 
successfully overcame her injury.
